about: Search checks for Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th edition (2016), on pages that were re-transcribed by the vision model in the first unit (sections 1.1 to 2.3). They need those transcriptions: run them with --transcripts-from pointing at an app database where unit 1 has been processed, together with strang-regression.json. Queries are written for this project; the book is not in the repository. Pages are 1-based PDF pages.

queries.query: clock face with twelve vectors from the center to each hour
queries.note: Only the transcription's figure description mentions the clock vectors.

queries.query: the vector (1,2,3) is the diagonal of a box with length square root of 14
queries.note: The figure description on PDF 23 ranks second, after the definition of length in the passage spanning PDF 22-23.

queries.query: unit vector u = (cos theta, sin theta) on the unit circle
queries.note: Stated in the text on PDF 23 and in the transcribed figure on PDF 24; either is right.

queries.query: angle between v and w is theta = beta minus alpha
queries.note: Figure description of the angle difference.

queries.query: backward differences of t squared give 2t - 1, not the derivative 2t
queries.note: Equation that the text layer garbles; the transcription has it in LaTeX.

queries.query: permutation matrix P23 exchanges rows 2 and 3
queries.note: The question is posed on PDF 72; the definition on PDF 73 is transcribed.

queries.query: if E adds row 1 to row 2 and F adds row 2 to row 1, is EF = FE
